description_en: Compares the similarity of the largest faces in two images. The largest face refers to the largest face frame in an image after face detection
description_zh: 比较两张图片中最大的人脸的相似度。最大的人脸指的是图片经人脸检测后，所有人脸框中面积最大的
name: CompareImageFaces

parameters.help_en: The name of the project. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html
parameters.name: project_name

fields.help_en: The ID of the account that you use to grant permissions
fields.name: assume_role_for

fields.help_en: The RAM role that can be assumed
fields.name: role

fields.help_en:
The role type. Valid values:

user: Alibaba Cloud account.
service: Alibaba Cloud service
fields.help_zh:
角色类型，可选值如下。
user：阿里云账号。
service：阿里云服务
fields.name: role_type

fields.help_en: The authorization chains. All roles in the array must have the `sts:AssumeRole` permission. You need to only grant other permissions, such as read and write permissions on OSS, to the last role in the array. You can grant permissions in the RAM console
fields.help_zh:
需要传递授权的链列表，数组中的所有角色都需要赋予访问 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限。
只有数组中的最后一个角色需要额外配置需要真正访问的其他权限，比如OSS的读写权限，可以通过RAM控制台进行授权操作
fields.name: chain

fields.help_en: The policy that is attached to the role specified by the ServiceRole parameter. For example, the policy allows access to OSS. This parameter is optional
fields.help_zh: ServiceRole参数的角色所需配置的权限策略，例如允许访问OSS。可选
fields.name: policy

fields.help_en: The service role in the account that is used to call an IMM API operation. The role must have the `sts:AssumeRole` permission. You can configure permissions for the role in the Resource Access Management (RAM) console
fields.help_zh: 服务角色，调用IMM接口的账号需要创建的一个角色，必须包含 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限，可以通过RAM控制台进行配置
fields.name: service_role

parameters.help_en:
If you have no special requirements, leave this parameter empty.

The authorization chain settings. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465340.html
parameters.help_zh:
如无特殊需求，请保持留空即可。

链式授权配置，非必填。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465340.html

fields.help_en:
The OSS URL of the image file.

Specify the URL in the `oss://<bucket>/<object>` format. `<bucket>` specifies the name of the OSS bucket that is in the same region as the current project. `<object>` specifies path of the object with the extension included
fields.help_zh:
图片的OSS地址。

地址规则为`oss://<bucket>/<object>`，其中`<bucket>`为和当前项目处于同一地域的OSS Bucket名称，`<object>`为包含文件扩展名的文件完整路径
fields.name: uri_1

fields.help_en:
The OSS URL of the image file.

Specify the URL in the `oss://<bucket>/<object>` format. `<bucket>` specifies the name of the OSS bucket that is in the same region as the current project, and `<object>` specifies the path of the object with the extension included
fields.help_zh:
图片的OSS地址。

地址规则为`oss://<bucket>/<object>`，其中`<bucket>`为和当前项目处于同一地域的OSS Bucket名称，`<object>`为包含文件扩展名的文件完整路径
fields.name: uri_2

parameters.name: source

Similarity.description_en: The face similarity. A larger value indicates a higher face similarity. Valid values: 0 to 1
Similarity.description_zh: 人脸相似度，该值越大则人脸相似度越高，取值范围为0～1
